label: Phase two — not lost, but weather
location: The highland pass, above the road

recentEvents.value: It called the turn three times, plain as a gust-call; the traveler heard, and walked on. Then he is not lost. He is weather.

unresolvedConflicts.value: It keeps solving him as a navigation problem; he has stopped being one.

notes: 'You hear me. You walk on anyway. Then you are not lost. You are weather.'
